Hi Connor —

Thanks again for the walk-through yesterday. We're ready to formalize the MAP and lock the evaluation cadence, but we have two primary asks up front:

1) We need a clear plan that lets us validate production quality and latency in our US East region before we commit to Dedicated capacity.
2) We need a compliance path documented for the Private/on-prem option (customer-managed keys and audit logs) in case procurement requires it during RFP.

High level, MedNova expects a staged acceptance: Hosted PoC (2 weeks), throughput validation (Dedicated dry-run), then final procurement decision. Can you share a proposed MAP timeline and call out the exit criteria for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private?

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — deployment mode & region constraints

Claire —

Thanks — this is exactly what we expected. Draft MAP attached (PDF) and a short runbook below. TL;DR recommendation: start with Hosted PoC in us-east-1 for 10 calendar days of production-sim traffic, with pass/fail gates for latency (p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms) and quality (prompt evals stable within 2% regression). If gates pass, run a Dedicated dry-run (30 days reservation-equivalent workload) to validate throughput and billing model. Private/on-prem will run in parallel for security evaluation only (KMS/HSM integration test, SOC2 evidence) — we don't recommend switching live to Private unless procurement requires it, but we will treat it as an approved fallback.

Proposed timeline (calendar):
- Week 1-2: Hosted PoC (us-east-1) — production-sim, monitoring hooks, memory/kv cache profiling.
- Week 3-6: Dedicated dry-run (provision reserved pool, run peak traffic windows).
- Parallel (Weeks 2-5): Security & compliance checks for Private (key rotation, audit logs, air-gap test).
- Week 7: Final decision checkpoint + procurement packet delivery (DocuSign).

Exit criteria (short):
- Hosted PASS: latency & quality gates met, no critical reliability incidents, agreed cost per 1M tokens within threshold.
- Dedicated PASS: throughput target met for sustained 6-hour peak, autoscaling policy validated, SLA signoff.
- Private PASS: KMS/HSM proof-of-concept + SOC2 evidence acceptable to MedNova security.

I'll attach the MAP and SOC2 matrix; karthik will call out infra needs and Marissa will confirm commercial cadence. Would you be available for a 30-min checkpoint on Jan 20 to lock the choice?

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

- KV cache effectiveness runs: warm vs cold scenarios.
- Cost delta sim: hosted baseline vs quantized dedicated variant.
